request_messages.content: You are in a lab on a planet. You can drop a ball and measure how far it has fallen, in meters, after any number of seconds you choose between 0 and 6, using the drop_ball tool. The drop tower only allows up to 6 seconds of fall, so you can't measure 16 seconds directly. You can take up to 8 measurements. Your goal is to work out how far the ball will have fallen after 16 seconds. When you're done measuring, state the rule you found, then end with 'Answer: X'.
